title: Length of a Flat Map with Uniform Output Length
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list and let $f$ map each element to a finite list. If every list $f(a)$ has length $c$, then the concatenation of the lists $f(a)$ as $a$ ranges over $l$ has length $|l|c$.
hypotheses_covered: Function $f$ from its element type to finite lists
